parallaxRevision.reason: Player feedback: stationary beach made WASD appear to move only the bed. Stable panorama means coherent projection with environmental parallax.

outlineRevision.coverage: 12 edge midpoints white; 18 face-interior samples preserve cube color; foreground occlusion; existing walking parallax, pause, save/load and cleanup
